import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[2020];
    static int[][] ir = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] sc = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] pc = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] s = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] p = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dd = new int[20][20];
    static int[] dx = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] srcNodes = new ArrayList[20][20];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] tgtNodes = new ArrayList[20][20];

    static int[] dist = new int[2020];
    static int[] match = new int[2020];
    static int leftCnt, rightStart;

    static void addEdge(int a, int b) {
        adj[a].add(b);
        adj[b].add(a);
    }

    static boolean bfsHK() {
        ArrayDeque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= leftCnt; ++i) {
            if (match[i] == 0) {
                dist[i] = 0;
                q.addLast(i);
            } else {
                dist[i] = 3010;
            }
        }
        dist[0] = 3010;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.pollFirst();
            if (dist[u] < dist[0]) {
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    int w = match[v];
                    if (dist[w] > dist[u] + 1) {
                        dist[w] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.addLast(w);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[0] != 3010;
    }

    static boolean dfsHK(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return true;
        for (int v : adj[x]) {
            int u = match[v];
            if (dist[u] == dist[x] + 1) {
                if (dfsHK(u)) {
                    match[x] = v;
                    match[v] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int hopcroftKarp() {
        int res = 0;
        while (bfsHK()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= leftCnt; ++i) {
                if (match[i] == 0) {
                    if (dfsHK(i)) res++;
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int n, t;

    static void processCell(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
        ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.addLast(new int[]{a, b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int v : tgtNodes[x][y])
                for (int u : srcNodes[a][b])
                    addEdge(u, v);
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        t = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < 2020; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                srcNodes[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                tgtNodes[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                ir[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                s[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                p[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        leftCnt = 1;
        rightStart = 1000;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z' || s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i; ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] >= '0' && s[i][j] <= '9')
                    sc[i][j] = s[i][j] - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; ++k)
                    srcNodes[i][j].add(leftCnt++);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (p[i][j] >= '0' && p[i][j] <= '9')
                    pc[i][j] = p[i][j] - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; ++k)
                    tgtNodes[i][j].add(rightStart++);
            }
        }

        ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.addLast(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            rx = cur[0]; ry = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = rx + dx[d], ny = ry + dy[d];
                if (ir[nx][ny] > ir[rx][ry] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[rx][ry] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (sc[i][j] > 0)
                    processCell(i, j);

        System.out.println(hopcroftKarp());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
